item.title: Hacker, Hipster, Hustler - which are you?
item.description:
Theres a role for everyone at RGUHack

The Hacker

Do you love working with new tools and frameworks? Wanting to code right away? You will be responsible for turning dreams and wireframes into apps and websites, no matter how many bugs you encounter. Making sure that the team vision is materialised and (hopefully) running.

The Hipster

Happen to find yourself looking at resolution of a logo or figuring out the font of a cafe menu for too long? You will make sure that whatever the team makes; looks, feels and sounds as awesome as possible with your artistic touch. Give that much-needed WOW factor to it all.

item.title: The Ultimate Hack List: Must Have Items at RGU Hack
item.description: Packing for a hackathon can be a confusing ordeal, especially if it is your first one. Do you bring a change of outfit?, a game to play for chill time?, snacks to get you through it? It can be an overwhelming experience. Not sure where to start? Don’t worry we have you covered. Check out the list below for must have items people always forget to improve your hack experience!
